sections.name: summary
sections.value: Class 3 — undeclared external binaries. Shipped in 038d1e50 (PR #118); two tasks remain open pending the consumer's reply.

value.title: Sweep class 3 by CLASS, not by the reported instance. Enumerate every real (unmocked) external-binary spawn in src and test, state the predicate so the count is auditable, and classify each site guarded/unguarded AND subject/mechanism. Both dimensions are disqualifying and neither is visible to a grep for spawn calls.

Eliminate the three MECHANISM binaries: grep -c -> countMatchingLines() (counts LINES, not occurrences — a match(/../g).length rewrite disagrees the moment two matches share a line); cp -> copyFileSync() (also converts a previously SILENT failed copy into a throw); chmod +x -> chmodSync(0o755).

Declare the two SUBJECT binaries with loud skips rather than rewriting them. New helper test/support/external-binary.ts: hasBinary() (per-process cached probe) + missingBinaryReason() naming the binary, why it cannot be substituted, and what specifically stopped being checked. An absent-binary skip that prints nothing is a control that passes by examining nothing.

Prove every change. POSITIVE control per rewrite, run in the same commit BEFORE deleting the binary: old and new against the same real fixture, asserted equal. NEGATIVE control per guard: force the probe to a non-existent binary and confirm the cases skip and the reason prints — tested separately for jq and bash, never assuming the second from the first.

Measure the windows-latest runner image rather than assuming it. Read the published manifest, record what is present, and STOP at its boundary — do not read the documented 'MSYS2 not on PATH' line as covering Git's bundled usr/bin, which is a different directory.

Ship as a consumable PR with honest numbers: three columns, an unproven number marked PENDING rather than asserted, the subject-vs-mechanism reasoning stated so a future contributor does not 'simplify' the probe-skips away, and the transitive-vs-direct guard distinction recorded so a future sweep does not re-derive the whole correction.

Resolve FAILURES FIXED from pending to measured, once the consumer sends failure signatures for post-commit-hook.test.ts (7) and cat-file-batch.int.test.ts (4). ENOENT means the eliminations were FIXES worth up to 11 more of their failures; anything else means they were hardening. Update the PR body either way — it currently carries a pending claim.

Agree the round-one set WITH the consumer before starting it. They rank what blocks them; we work their order. Size is not the same as blocking, and the largest failing file may be irrelevant to what they ship.

Coordinate with pij-tiny-bug BEFORE measuring anything for class 4. Its #109 instrument already exists (spawn/fs counters + per-file attribution), so rebuilding it is the duplication this fleet is trying to avoid. Treat its numbers as LOWER bounds: fs-write columns patch writeFileSync and the fs.promises family but not the fd API, and grandchild processes are undercounted.

Establish the consumer's delivery path rather than inferring it. If their shipping artefact comes from the registry, none of this work reaches them until a release ships — latest published is 0.13.0, main is 0.13.0, and the bump sits in release-please #84. If it IS the registry, note that a green tag plus a GitHub release is NOT a published package (npm --provenance rejects private repos with E422; bit us on #56), so the registry must be verified separately.
